query: session time pricing cost per minute

text: Moss Session is billed at $0.02 per session minute. 20 sessions x 15 minutes = 300 session minutes, so 300 x $0.02 = $6.00 in session time. (This is paid from credits; the Hobbyist plan includes $10/mo credits and allows 10 concurrent sessions, Startup includes $50/mo and up to 150, so 20 concurrent sessions needs Startup or higher.)
